teaching_clarity.rationale: One harmless matched-actor puzzle becomes a causal trial, an instrument-failure safeguard, a D0-D5 ladder with named bridges, and a bounded expiring dossier rather than a portable danger label.

composition.rationale: All 75 beat-boundary samples preserve readable hierarchy among the maze, trial rails, positive controls, ladder, disclosure surfaces, dossier, evidence boundary, and military-AI handoff.

motion_quality.rationale: Matched starts, the novice bottleneck crossing, cohort separation, rail matching, failed-control rejection, rung promotions and recoil, disclosure split, review fork, expiry, and handoff all encode a change in causal or governance state.

synchronization.rationale: Twenty-five receipt-derived beats, the exact 299.945-second narration and mux, 85 caption cues, and 75 start-middle-end samples agree; the first animatic was rejected because local rejection crosses accumulated into later scenes, then corrected and rerendered.

continuity.rationale: The novice and expert, assistance delta, instrument receipt, D0-D5 ladder, restricted annex, public card, and expiring packet give stable identities across trial construction, inference, disclosure, and downstream use.

pacing.rationale: The 698-word script plays at about 140 words per minute and five semantic beats per minute, alternating quick experimental contrasts with deliberate holds on controls, bridge locks, evidence boundaries, and maximum inference.

voice.rationale: The narration is concrete, causal, and restrained; it repeatedly names the exact actor-system effect, distinguishes six quantities, protects the null, and refuses to promote a safe analogue into a hazardous-domain claim.

sound_mix.rationale: The narration-only animatic decodes cleanly at 48 kilohertz mono and measures minus 16.4 LUFS integrated, 3.1 LU range, and minus 1.4 dBTP, with no detected three-second silence.

engagement.rationale: The opening creates a counterintuitive novice-versus-expert puzzle; the failed positive-control reversal, ladder recoil, scalar-score rejection, review fork, and expiry transition create distinct prediction and payoff moments.

accessibility.rationale: Every condition and state duplicates color with labels, geometry, position, shape, or line style; the descriptive transcript covers material changes; and all 85 cues pass overlap, duration, word-count, character-count, and representative-frame review.

claim_fidelity.rationale: The harmless analogue and final evidence boundary visibly limit support to a design rationale and public-safe architecture; no uplift estimate, threshold, safeguard result, field consequence, danger finding, or safety finding is implied.

non_claim: Passing this animatic records a chapter-specific audiovisual teaching candidate only; picture-and-sound lock, release candidate, independent review, publication, and any book-evidence promotion remain ungranted.
